:::{#lem-cross-term-zero}
#### The conditional mean's error is uncorrelated with any function of the input

Let $\truemeanf{\Predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$ be the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar$.
For any [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn$ with $\E{\predfnf{\Predvar}^2} < \infty$:

$$\E{\prederrf{\truemean} \cd \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}} = 0$$

:::

::: proof

Because $\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}$ is a function of $\Predvar$,
by @thm-cond-pull-out it factors out of the [conditional expectation](#def-cond-expectation):

$$
\ba
\E{\prederrf{\truemean}\paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}} \mid \Predvar}
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}} \cd \E{\prederrf{\truemean} \mid \Predvar}
&& \text{(a function of } \Predvar \text{ factors out)} \\
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}} \cd \E{\truemeanf{\Predvar} - \Outvar \mid \Predvar}
&& \text{(definition of } \prederrf{\truemean} \text{)} \\
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}} \cd \paren{\E{\truemeanf{\Predvar} \mid \Predvar} - \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(linearity of conditional expectation)} \\
&= \paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}} \cd \paren{\truemeanf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(a function of } \Predvar \text{ is its own conditional mean, and definition of } \truemeanf{\Predvar} \text{)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(evaluate)}
\ea
$$

By the law of iterated expectations (@thm-lie):

$$
\ba
\E{\prederrf{\truemean}\paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}}}
&= \E{\E{\prederrf{\truemean}\paren{\predfnf{\Predvar} - \truemeanf{\Predvar}} \mid \Predvar}}
&& \text{(law of iterated expectations)} \\
&= \E{0}
&& \text{(the conditional expectation is } 0 \text{)} \\
&= 0
&& \text{(expectation of a constant)}
\ea
$$

:::
